import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
dt = "2026-11-05"
paths = [
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print(f"\n===== {p} =====")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    print("MISSING"); continue
  n=0
  with open(p, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # try extract date
      ts = o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('timestamp') or ''
      text = json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
      if dt not in str(ts) and dt not in text[:500] and f"2026-11-05" not in text:
        # also check epoch
        ok=False
        for k in ('ts','timestamp','created_at','t'):
          v=o.get(k)
          if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            try:
              d=datetime.fromtimestamp(v/1000 if v>1e12 else v, TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
              if d==dt: ok=True
            except Exception: pass
        if not ok: continue
      src = o.get('source') or o.get('from') or o.get('kind') or ''
      bus = o.get('bus_id') or o.get('id') or o.get('reply_to_bus_id') or ''
      summary = o.get('summary') or o.get('text') or o.get('content') or o.get('prompt') or ''
      if isinstance(summary, dict): summary=json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False)
      summary = str(summary).replace('\n',' ')[:220]
      print(f"{ts}|src={src}|bus={bus}|{summary}")
      n+=1
      if n>=80: print('...(cap)'); break
  print(f"count={n}")

import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
dt = "2026-11-05"
paths = [
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/sent.json"),
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_outbox.jsonl"),
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/replies.jsonl"),
]
for p in paths:
  print(f"\n===== {os.path.basename(p)} exists={os.path.exists(p)} =====")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  if p.endswith('.json'):
    try:
      data=json.load(open(p))
      if isinstance(data, dict):
        items = data.get('items') or data.get('sent') or list(data.values())
        if isinstance(items, dict): items=list(items.values())
      else:
        items=data
      n=0
      for o in items:
        if not isinstance(o, dict): continue
        text=json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
        if dt not in text: continue
        bus=o.get('bus_id') or o.get('reply_to_bus_id') or o.get('id')
        summary=(o.get('text') or o.get('content') or '')[:300]
        print(f"bus={bus}|{summary.replace(chr(10),' ')}")
        n+=1
        if n>=40: break
      print('count',n)
    except Exception as e:
      print('err',e)
  else:
    n=0
    with open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
      for line in f:
        if dt not in line: continue
        try: o=json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        bus=o.get('bus_id') or o.get('reply_to_bus_id') or o.get('id')
        summary=(o.get('text') or o.get('content') or o.get('prompt') or '')
        if isinstance(summary,dict): summary=json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False)
        print(f"bus={bus}|{str(summary).replace(chr(10),' ')[:300]}")
        n+=1
        if n>=50: break
    print('count',n)

import json
p="/Users/mac/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_sent.json"
data=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
# data might be dict keyed by reply:bus:N
if isinstance(data, dict) and any(str(k).startswith('reply:') for k in data):
  items=[]
  for k,v in data.items():
    if not str(k).startswith('reply:bus:'): continue
    if isinstance(v, dict):
      o=dict(v); o['_key']=k
      items.append(o)
    elif isinstance(v, list):
      for x in v:
        if isinstance(x,dict):
          o=dict(x); o['_key']=k; items.append(o)
else:
  items=[x for x in (data if isinstance(data,list) else []) if isinstance(x,dict)]

def blob(o):
  return json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)

want={'12440','12444','12448','12452','12453','12455','12456'}
for o in items:
  key=o.get('_key','')
  bus=str(o.get('bus_id') or o.get('reply_to_bus_id') or '')
  if not any(w in key or w==bus or w in blob(o) for w in want):
    continue
  text=o.get('text') or o.get('content') or o.get('body') or ''
  ts=o.get('sent_at') or o.get('ts') or o.get('created_at') or ''
  print(f"\n==== {key or bus} ts={ts} ====")
  print(str(text)[:1200])
